title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - Firmware
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/Firmware. [COSEM] This class holds identification information related to administration and maintenance of meters. They are not communication parameters but allow the device management.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Firmware'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasFirmwareVersion.description: Property. [COSEM] Textual description of the firmware version running on the device.

hasVendorId.description: Property. [COSEM] Unique vendor identifier assigned by the PRIME Alliance.

hasProductId.description: Property. [COSEM] Vendor-assigned unique identifier for the specific product.

hasObis.description: Property. [COSEM/IEC 62056] OBIS (OBject Identification System) code uniquely identifying this COSEM object instance within the metering equipment.
